label: PF Backlog 472
title: web_search tool (neutral; reuses PF http_get/requests; pluggable backend searxng/whoogle; default off)
body:
Source: user request (2026-10-08), from docs/TOOLS-AND-DEPENDENCIES.md section 7.

Goal: add a neutral `web_search` tool to PF's framework-agnostic tool layer, so research/domain/tech-stack agents
can query the web (today only `http_get` for KNOWN urls exists). BUILD ON WHAT PF ALREADY HAS: the tool performs an
HTTP GET via PF's existing `requests`/`http_get` capability to a configured search endpoint and parses results -
NO new library/dependency.

Design:
- ToolSpec `web_search` registered in core/tool_registry.py; handler does GET {endpoint}?q=... (reuse requests).
- Backends (configurable; default disabled/offline-safe): `none` (default) | `whoogle` (self-host, MIT) | `searxng`
  (self-host, supports format=json) | `duckduckgo_html` (HTML scrape; ToS caveat). Config via
  config/tools.json or env PF_WEB_SEARCH_BACKEND / PF_WEB_SEARCH_URL.
- tool_policy.WEB_TOOLS += ("web_search",) so research/domain/market roles get it.
- tool_cache caches results; bounded (limit N, timeout). Exposed automatically via PF's loop AND MCP.
- Licensing/redistribution (per BI-PF-0436/0437): reuse PF's own HTTP (MIT); prefer SELF-HOST whoogle(MIT)/searxng
  (operator-run) via base_url; never bundle a vendor SDK/key; ddg-html is opt-in (ToS).

Out of scope (follow-ups): BYO-key cloud adapters (brave/tavily/serpapi); semantic rerank; embeddings.

dashboard_impact: no UI surface.

## Amendment (user, 2026-10-08)
- **Default backend = SELF-HOST Whoogle (MIT)** (SearXNG as the alternative, operator-run). PF ships only the
  thin client (no engine, no key). "PF having web search" = the neutral `web_search` tool + the same tools
  exposed over MCP; the engine runs on the operator's infra.
- **MCP + keys:** MCP is just a protocol (no key). An MCP *search server* only needs a key if it wraps a CLOUD
  provider (Brave/Tavily/…, free-tier or paid); MCP servers backed by Self-host (Whoogle/SearXNG) or
  DuckDuckGo need NO key. So PF can offer key-free web search by self-hosting; cloud (via MCP or a tool adapter)
  is optional bring-your-own-key.


## Scope amendment (user, 2026-10-08)
Cloud BYO-key adapters are IN SCOPE (not just a follow-up): **brave** (X-Subscription-Token) and **tavily**
(api_key) alongside the self-host defaults. When PF ships, a customer points `PF_WEB_SEARCH_BACKEND` at a cloud
provider and supplies **their own key/account** (PF ships no keys). Backends: none(default) | whoogle | searxng |
duckduckgo_html | brave | tavily. Config via env (PF_WEB_SEARCH_BACKEND / PF_WEB_SEARCH_URL / PF_WEB_SEARCH_KEY,
or the provider's key env e.g. BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY / TAVILY_API_KEY).

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; fast precheck PASS; 4 tests. ToolRegistry web_search ToolSpec (reuses requests; no new dependency): backends none(default disabled) | searxng(json) | whoogle | duckduckgo_html | brave/tavily (BYO-key). tool_policy.WEB_TOOLS grants it to research roles; auto-exposed via PF loop + MCP. env flags registered (PF_WEB_SEARCH_BACKEND/_URL/_KEY).

decisions.decision: Include cloud BYO-key search adapters (brave, tavily) in scope so customers can bring their own key/account at ship time

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_tool_loop.py, core/tool_cache.py, core/tool_policy.py, core/tool_registry.py

_note: web_search tool delivered (self-host default + BYO-key cloud)
